{{Current events|year=2019|month=12|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Russia]] and [[China]] inaugurate their joint [[Power of Siberia]] [[Pipeline transport#Oil and natural gas|gas pipeline]]. [https://www.seattletimes.com/business/china-russia-launch-massive-joint-gas-pipeline/ (''The Seattle Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Thirteen [[Pakistanis in Jordan|Pakistani]] nationals, including eight children and four women, have died and three others are injured in a fire at a farm in rural [[Jordan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-50626792 (BBC)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**Police urge people to respect the [[curfew]]. Authorities order that children stay at home and announce that [[Christmas traditions|Christmas celebrations]] and public gatherings have been cancelled in order to prevent the [[epidemic]] from spreading even further. The death toll from the outbreak now stands at 53. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404589/children-stay-home-christmas-gatherings-cancelled-in-samoa (RNZ)] [https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/south-pacific/117856947/samoa-measles-five-more-deaths-over-night-brings-tally-to-53 (Stuff.co.nz)] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404651/samoa-measles-outbreak-police-urge-public-to-keep-to-curfew (RNZ<sub>2</sub>)]

;International relations
*[[China–United States relations]]
**[[China]] bans visits by [[United States military]] ships to [[Hong Kong]] and sanctions five U.S. [[Non-governmental organization|NGO]]s, in response to the American [[Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act]] passed last week. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/12/02/china-suspends-review-of-request-for-us-military-ships-to-hong-kong.html (CNBC)]
*[[International Atomic Energy Agency]] approved [[Rafael Grossi]] as the new Director General.[https://www.iaea.org/newscenter/pressreleases/iaea-rafael-mariano-grossi-to-assume-office-as-director-general-on-3-december (IAEA)]

;Law and crime
*A 12-year-old boy is killed and five other people are injured in a deliberate [[hit-and-run]] crash near a school in [[Loughton]], [[Essex]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-essex-50637430 (BBC)]
*A man [[suicide in Canada|shoots himself]] on the steps of the [[Alberta Legislature Building]] in [[Edmonton]], [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], causing an early adjournment of the day's [[question period]]. The individual is pronounced dead at the scene. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6246038/alberta-legislature-postponed-man-shoots-himself/?utm_medium=Twitter&utm_source=%40GlobalEdmonton (Global)]
